{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Count total number of rows (enrolled patients, even those with QC failures)
# We are not filtering out biomarker_baseline == -999 for this question
# Because enrollment ≠ measurement validity

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once, with their most recent (highest sample_seq) record
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated_data)

# Print the result
print(f"Final number of unique patients (after deduplication): {num_patients}")"}
